nodes.question: What contributions do Zhou et al. (2023) and Duqi (2023) make to the understanding of the economic impacts of disasters?
nodes.answer: Zhou et al. (2023) provide broad overviews covering insurance, equity markets, bond markets, international financial flows, and the banking sector, while Duqi (2023) offers regulatory context and foundational theories suitable for educational purposes.
